Backfill implemented: signet_store_list_agents_missing_pubkey + signet_store_set_agent_pubkey (backfill-only, validates+canonicalizes 64-hex lowercase), signet_key_store_backfill_pubkeys (decrypt+derive+persist, idempotent, store errors abort with -1, undecryptable rows counted failed and surfaced), signetd runs it at startup with logged counts. test_pubkey_backfill.c proves pre-backfill invisibility, derivation, idempotency, PUBKEY_EXISTS on adopting a backfilled key, no-overwrite, non-hex rejection, case canonicalization. Partial unique index deliberately NOT added: INSERT OR REPLACE + unique index would silently delete the conflicting agent row — follow-up filed for ON CONFLICT rewrite + index. Covered by signetctl reissue-connect (shipped in nostrc-6jm, commit 8b0ccd3d): sends the gift-wrapped agent/reissue-connect 25910 intent as an authorized provisioner, waits for the encrypted correlated reply, and with --out <path> atomically writes the fresh connect_secret (O_EXCL temp + fsync + rename + dir fsync, 0600) without printing it — exactly the helper contract. openclaw-nostr's nip46ConnectSecretRefresh exec action can invoke: signetctl reissue-connect <agent_id> --out <path>. A separate Go binary is unnecessary; reopen if a no-GLib deployment target emerges.

put_agent_ex switched to INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(agent_id) DO UPDATE (preserves same-agent replace semantics; pubkey/connect_secret conflicts with other agents now error instead of deleting rows); partial unique index idx_agents_pubkey_unique added via tolerated migration with g_warning on legacy-duplicate failure; put_agent_ex validates+canonicalizes pubkeys to lowercase; constraint mapping uses sqlite3_extended_errcode (UNIQUE/PRIMARYKEY -> 1); adopt maps conflicts to PUBKEY_EXISTS via re-check, provision/rotate normalize to error; backfill counts duplicate-legacy-key conflicts per-row (rc 2) instead of aborting the pass. Tests cover upsert replace, cross-agent pubkey/secret conflicts with intact rows, case-insensitivity, malformed pubkeys, and duplicate-legacy-key backfill. Full signet suite green.
